findings.issue: The graph is extremely cluttered with overlapping text, tiny nodes, and messy lines, making it impossible to read what is happening.
findings.fix: Clean up the graph layout to match the reference, using larger spaced-out nodes with clear labels and directional arrows.

findings.element: NodeAgent sidebar / chat panel in main area
findings.issue: The NODEAGENT panel and the search/filter bar above the graph add excessive cognitive load and distract from the primary entity graph.
findings.fix: Remove the secondary NODEAGENT panel and filter bar from the Entity view to focus on the graph itself, as shown in the reference.

findings.issue: The version badges for NodeAgent reconciliations show v1 -> v1, which is incorrect and doesn't match the current room state of v42.
findings.fix: Update the version badges to show the correct progression (e.g., v41 -> v42 and v42 -> v43) to maintain trust and provenance.

findings.issue: Node labels are rendered as raw, tiny, overlapping text strings without containers, severely degrading readability and visual hierarchy.
findings.fix: Wrap node labels in pill-shaped container badges with standardized, sober typography as seen in the reference.

findings.issue: The persistent right-hand panel inside the graph canvas introduces excessive typographic noise (all-caps headers, multiple button labels, input placeholders) that competes with the main visualization.
findings.fix: Remove or collapse this panel to allow the primary entity graph to carry focus, matching the clean layout of the reference.

findings.issue: The secondary search input and filter buttons ('Evidence', 'Agent', 'Human') clutter the top of the canvas and disrupt the clean hierarchy.
findings.fix: Remove these extra inline controls to restore the minimalist toolbar layout of the reference.

findings.issue: The secondary toolbar containing search, filter pills, and time-range buttons introduces excessive control density, violating the calm-room target.
findings.fix: Remove the secondary filter toolbar and search bar, keeping only the primary view tabs as seen in the reference.

findings.issue: The right-aligned NodeAgent panel inside the graph workspace squeezes the canvas, causing text overlaps and high visual density.
findings.fix: Remove this inline sidebar to restore the spacious, single-focus layout of the entity graph.

findings.issue: The mini-map overlay in the bottom-right corner of the graph canvas adds unnecessary visual noise and extra control elements.
findings.fix: Remove the mini-map overlay to maintain a clean, uncluttered canvas area.

findings.issue: Uses the reserved terracotta accent color for active filter states, diluting the agent focus signal.
findings.fix: Recolor active filter states to a neutral medium-gray or muted secondary color instead of terracotta.

findings.issue: Displays a stack of highly saturated multi-colored bars, creating unnecessary visual noise.
findings.fix: Mute or desaturate the mini-map indicator colors to maintain a calm, neutral background.
